notes.title: Me in the Office - Launch Trailer
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32941352/ff4b72c561bcc2ac78445442d39b9fe0cf8c79d0.png[/img]
Hello everyone! 

I am happy to introduce you the launch trailer for my new game Me in the Office.  The game has been published today after a long and difficult time in development. I really enjoyed all the development process and now the game is ready against all odds. I am thankful to everyone who supports me during this time. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=me-Y_dfMggI

notes.title: Me in the Office - Major Destructions
notes.content:

notes.title: UPDATE v1.05
notes.content:
We are happy to release a large update based on your community feedback. The update introduces mouse support, 250 Steam Achievements, Steam Cloud, various physics improvements, and bug fixes.

We hope you enjoy the new update. Version 1.05 is a major step forward for Inside the Gear. Thanks for your continued support!
